summary: The AI project cycle is a six-stage framework for developing AI solutions. The stages are problem scoping, data acquisition, data exploration, modeling, evaluation, and deployment. Problem scoping defines the problem using the four Ws: Who, What, Where, and Why. Data acquisition involves collecting relevant data. Data exploration uses visualization to discover patterns. Modeling uses machine learning techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning. Evaluation measures how well the model performs. Deployment puts the completed AI solution into the real world.
